<p class="diagram-note">时序图：在轮询或中断模式下请求缓冲区、下发发送任务并接收确认。来源：<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00067" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00067">[SWS_EthIf_00067]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00075" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00075">[SWS_EthIf_00075]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00250" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00250">[SWS_EthIf_00250]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00113" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00113">[SWS_EthIf_00113]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00255" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00255">[SWS_EthIf_00255]</a>、<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/figures/FIG-5941c70928c07c07.html" data-snip="FIG-5941c70928c07c07">SWS EthIf 第87页</a>、<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/figures/FIG-398a026bccb0cfe2.html" data-snip="FIG-398a026bccb0cfe2">SWS EthIf 第88页</a></p>
<p>与后续 Release 的差异：</p>
<ul>
<li>在 R24-11 中，<code>EthIf_Transmit</code> 具有基于 PDU 的签名 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_4_1_13_EthIf_Transmit.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_4_1_13_EthIf_Transmit">SWS EthIf 第97页</a>。对 R20-11 具有规范约束力的是包含 <code>CtrlIdx</code> 和 <code>BufIdx</code> 的签名 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00075" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00075">[SWS_EthIf_00075]</a>。</li>
<li>模式 <code>ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_TX_OFFLINE</code> 以及发送转发与控制器模式的耦合，仅在 R23-11 起的文档出处中有所描述 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_7_1_10_Communication_control.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_7_1_10_Communication_control">SWS EthIf 第34页</a>。有效负载中不包含针对此内容的 R20-11 需求。</li>
</ul>
<p>驱动程序通过 <code>EthIf_RxIndication</code> 报告接收到的帧 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00085" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00085">[SWS_EthIf_00085]</a>。EthIf 将其传递给 <code>&lt;User&gt;_RxIndication</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00104" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00104">[SWS_EthIf_00104]</a>。在轮询模式下，<code>EthIf_MainFunctionRx</code> 周期性检查是否有新帧 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00097" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00097">[SWS_EthIf_00097]</a>。具有优先级的变体为此使用相应的 <code>FifoIdx</code> 调用 <code>Eth_Receive</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91051" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91051">[SWS_EthIf_91051]</a>。接收检查是否处于激活状态由 <code>EthIfEnableRxInterrupt</code> 控制 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_6_1_EthIf_MainFunctionRx.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_6_1_EthIf_MainFunctionRx">SWS EthIf 第174页</a>。</p>

<h4>交换机端口、端口组和链路状态</h4>
<p>端口组通过从零开始的索引 <code>EthIf_SwitchPortGroupIdxType</code> 进行寻址 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91101" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91101">[SWS_EthIf_91101]</a>。其模式由 <code>EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode</code> 异步请求 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91102" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91102">[SWS_EthIf_91102]</a>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>ETH_MODE_ACTIVE</code>：</strong>EthIf 通过 <code>EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode</code> 和 <code>EthSwt_PortLinkStateRequest</code> 接通端口 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00272" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00272">[SWS_EthIf_00272]</a>。</li>
<li><strong><code>ETH_MODE_DOWN</code>：</strong>仅当引用该端口的所有组都已请求 DOWN 时，定时器 <code>EthIfSwitchOffPortTimedelay</code> 才会针对该端口启动 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00270" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00270">[SWS_EthIf_00270]</a>。超时后，接下来执行带有 <code>ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN</code> 的 <code>EthSwt_PortLinkStateRequest</code> 以及带有 <code>ETH_MODE_DOWN</code> 的 <code>EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00271" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00271">[SWS_EthIf_00271]</a>。</li>
<li><strong>在关断定时器运行期间再次请求 ACTIVE：</strong><a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00483" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00483">[SWS_EthIf_00483]</a> 规定了这种情况；推测定时器会被停止。</li>
</ul>
<p><code>EthIf_StartAllPorts</code> 激活所有受影响的端口 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00275" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00275">[SWS_EthIf_00275]</a>。对于在 <code>EthIfPortStartupActiveTime</code> 到期前未以 ACTIVE 进行请求的端口，EthIf 会将其重新停用 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00276" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00276">[SWS_EthIf_00276]</a>。</p>

<p class="diagram-note">状态图：端口组控制下交换机端口的生命周期，包含关断和启动定时器。来源：<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00270" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00270">[SWS_EthIf_00270]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00271" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00271">[SWS_EthIf_00271]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00272" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00272">[SWS_EthIf_00272]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00483" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00483">[SWS_EthIf_00483]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00275" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00275">[SWS_EthIf_00275]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00276" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00276">[SWS_EthIf_00276]</a></p>
<p>EthIf 汇集硬件的链路状态：</p>
<ul>
<li>不带收发器的控制器被视为 <code>ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00229" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00229">[SWS_EthIf_00229]</a>。</li>
<li>每次发生变更时，EthIf 会针对每个受影响的控制器调用 <code>&lt;User&gt;_TrcvLinkStateChg</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00230" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00230">[SWS_EthIf_00230]</a>。</li>
<li>对于没有端口组的交换机，以主机端口的状态为准 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00260" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00260">[SWS_EthIf_00260]</a>。</li>
<li>对于端口组，EthIf 会形成一个累积状态 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00259" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00259">[SWS_EthIf_00259]</a>。该状态会报告给 EthSM <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00262" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00262">[SWS_EthIf_00262]</a>，或者在未分配控制器的情况下报告给 BswM <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00261" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00261">[SWS_EthIf_00261]</a>。</li>
</ul>
<p><code>EthIf_MainFunctionState</code> 以 <code>EthIfMainFunctionStatePeriod</code> 的节拍进行轮询 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00407" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00407">[SWS_EthIf_00407]</a>。对于处于活动状态的链路，该函数读取信号质量（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00408" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00408">[SWS_EthIf_00408]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00409" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00409">[SWS_EthIf_00409]</a>）。自上次清除以来的当前值、最高值和最低值会被保存 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91057" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91057">[SWS_EthIf_91057]</a>。</p>

<h4>唤醒检查与休眠指示</h4>
<p><code>EthIf_CheckWakeup</code> 是异步且可重入的。该服务请求受影响的硬件检查已发出信号的唤醒 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00244" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00244">[SWS_EthIf_00244]</a>。根据规范，集成代码会调用该服务 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_4_EthIf_CheckWakeup.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_4_EthIf_CheckWakeup">SWS EthIf 第56页</a>。EthIf 转发至：</p>
<ul>
<li>所有受影响收发器的 <code>EthTrcv_CheckWakeup</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00245" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00245">[SWS_EthIf_00245]</a>，</li>
<li>所有受影响交换机的 <code>EthSwt_SwitchCheckWakeup</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00500" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00500">[SWS_EthIf_00500]</a>。</li>
</ul>
<p>该服务可以通过 <code>EthIfWakeUpSupport</code> 进行关闭 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00248" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00248">[SWS_EthIf_00248]</a>。</p>
<p>唤醒原因由两个服务提供（两者均为 DRAFT）：</p>
<ul>
<li>通过 <code>EthTrcv_GetBusWuReason</code> 的 <code>EthIf_GetPhyWakeupReason</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00486" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00486">[SWS_EthIf_00486]</a>，</li>
<li>对于交换机端口，为对 <code>EthSwt_GetSwitchPortWakeupReason</code> 的调用 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00490" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00490">[SWS_EthIf_00490]</a>。</li>
</ul>
<p>通过 <code>EthIf_SleepIndication</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91006">[SWS_EthIf_91006]</a> 发出的休眠通知由 EthIf 转发给 <code>EthSM_SleepIndication</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00497" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00497">[SWS_EthIf_00497]</a>。<code>EthIf_SetTransceiverWakeupMode</code> 和 <code>EthIf_GetTransceiverWakeupMode</code> 在 R20-11 中已废弃（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00233" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00233">[SWS_EthIf_00233]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00238" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00238">[SWS_EthIf_00238]</a>）。</p>

<p class="diagram-note">时序图：唤醒检查贯穿所有受影响的收发器和交换机。EcuM 图表来自 R21-11 起的 Release。来源：<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00244" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00244">[SWS_EthIf_00244]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00245" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00245">[SWS_EthIf_00245]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00500" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00500">[SWS_EthIf_00500]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00486" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00486">[SWS_EthIf_00486]</a>、<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/figures/FIG-4730d5e9bb4d6146.html" data-snip="FIG-4730d5e9bb4d6146">SWS EcuM 第189页</a></p>

<h4>作为透传的诊断、时间戳和无线服务</h4>
<p>该 API 的很大一部分将调用透传给驱动程序：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>至 EthTrcv：</strong>测试模式、回环、电缆诊断和 PHY 标识符（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00324" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00324">[SWS_EthIf_00324]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91018" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91018">[SWS_EthIf_91018]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91014" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91014">[SWS_EthIf_91014]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00334" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00334">[SWS_EthIf_00334]</a>）。</li>
<li><strong>至 EthSwt：</strong>端口模式、计数器、统计信息、端口镜像和配置数据（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00415" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00415">[SWS_EthIf_00415]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00432" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00432">[SWS_EthIf_00432]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00436" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00436">[SWS_EthIf_00436]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00448" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00448">[SWS_EthIf_00448]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00454" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00454">[SWS_EthIf_00454]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00468" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00468">[SWS_EthIf_00468]</a>）。</li>
</ul>
<p>有两个服务所做的不只是透传。<code>EthIf_RunPortCableDiagnostic</code> 确保关联的 <code>EthIfController</code> 处于 <code>ETH_MODE_ACTIVE</code> 中 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00464" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00464">[SWS_EthIf_00464]</a>。<code>EthIf_GetPortMacAddr</code> 会查询所有交换机驱动程序，并在没有端口或有多个端口匹配时返回 <code>E_NOT_OK</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00191" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00191">[SWS_EthIf_00191]</a>。</p>
<p>针对时间同步提供了三个服务（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00160" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00160">[SWS_EthIf_00160]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00166" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00166">[SWS_EthIf_00166]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00172" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00172">[SWS_EthIf_00172]</a>）：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>EthIf_EnableEgressTimeStamp</code> 启用发送缓冲区的出向（Egress）打时间戳。</li>
<li><code>EthIf_GetEgressTimeStamp</code> 和 <code>EthIf_GetIngressTimeStamp</code> 读取时间戳。</li>
</ul>
<p>这三者都可以通过 <code>EthIfGlobalTimeSupport</code> 进行开关控制（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00164" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00164">[SWS_EthIf_00164]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00170" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00170">[SWS_EthIf_00170]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00176" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00176">[SWS_EthIf_00176]</a>）。根据 R23-11 中的一处文档内容，入向（Ingress）查询必须在 Rx 指示内部进行 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_25_EthIf_GetIngressTimeStamp.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_25_EthIf_GetIngressTimeStamp">SWS EthIf 第76页</a>。与 EthTSyn 的交互如 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/figures/FIG-cbcadeed7ab76217.html" data-snip="FIG-cbcadeed7ab76217">SWS TimeSync 第55页</a> 所示。</p>
<p>对于交换机，<code>EthIf_SetSwitchMgmtInfo</code> 设置管理信息 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91003" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91003">[SWS_EthIf_91003]</a>。<code>EthIf_SwitchEnableTimeStamping</code> 针对组的每个端口调用 <code>EthSwt_PortEnableTimeStamp</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00387" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00387">[SWS_EthIf_00387]</a>。该功能通过 <code>EthIfSwitchManagementSupport</code> 进行控制 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00279" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00279">[SWS_EthIf_00279]</a>。</p>
<p>与后续 Release 的差异：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>EthIf_GetCurrentTime</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00154" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00154">[SWS_EthIf_00154]</a> 自 R23-11 起已废弃 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_17_EthIf_GetCurrentTime.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_17_EthIf_GetCurrentTime">SWS EthIf 第68页</a>。</li>
<li>R25-11 通过 <code>PduId</code> 而非 <code>CtrlIdx</code>/<code>BufIdx</code> 来寻址 <code>EthIf_EnableEgressTimeStamp</code> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_4_6_3_EthIf_EnableEgressTimeStamp.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_4_6_3_EthIf_EnableEgressTimeStamp">SWS EthIf 第155页</a>。</li>
</ul>
<p>无线功能通过 <code>EthIfEnableWEthApi</code> 启用 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00340" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00340">[SWS_EthIf_00340]</a> 并转发至 WEth 或 WEthTrcv（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00341" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00341">[SWS_EthIf_00341]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00353" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00353">[SWS_EthIf_00353]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00360" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00360">[SWS_EthIf_00360]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00366" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00366">[SWS_EthIf_00366]</a>）。许多可选服务可在编译时关闭，例如通过 <code>EthIfStoreConfigurationApi</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00216" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00216">[SWS_EthIf_00216]</a> 或 <code>EthIfVerifyConfigApi</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00305" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00305">[SWS_EthIf_00305]</a>。</p>

<h4>发生错误时的行为</h4>
<p>开发错误代码由 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00017" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00017">[SWS_EthIf_00017]</a> 规定，例如 <code>ETHIF_E_INV_CTRL_IDX</code>（0x01）和 <code>ETHIF_E_INV_TRCV_IDX</code>（0x02）。典型的检查分为三个阶段：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>初始化：</strong><code>ETHIF_E_UNINIT</code>。</li>
<li><strong>索引：</strong><code>ETHIF_E_INV_CTRL_IDX</code>、<code>ETHIF_E_INV_TRCV_IDX</code>、<code>ETHIF_E_INV_SWT_IDX</code>、<code>ETHIF_E_INV_PORT_IDX</code>。</li>
<li><strong>指针：</strong><code>ETHIF_E_PARAM_POINTER</code>。</li>
</ol>
<p>示例包括时间戳服务（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00167" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00167">[SWS_EthIf_00167]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00168" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00168">[SWS_EthIf_00168]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00169" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00169">[SWS_EthIf_00169]</a>）和交换机端口唤醒原因查询（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00491" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00491">[SWS_EthIf_00491]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00492" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00492">[SWS_EthIf_00492]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00493" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00493">[SWS_EthIf_00493]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00494" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00494">[SWS_EthIf_00494]</a>）。对于许多服务明确规定：如果关闭了 DET，函数将改为返回 <code>E_NOT_OK</code>（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00325" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00325">[SWS_EthIf_00325]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00326" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00326">[SWS_EthIf_00326]</a>）。</p>
<p>错误检测中的两个特殊情况：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode</code> 会拒绝分配给 <code>EthIfController</code> 的端口组。随后该服务会报告 <code>ETHIF_E_INV_PORT_GROUP_IDX</code> 并返回 <code>E_NOT_OK</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00274" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00274">[SWS_EthIf_00274]</a>。</li>
<li><a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00319" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00319">[SWS_EthIf_00319]</a> 给出了不同的错误代码 <code>ETHIF_E_NOTINIT</code>。</li>
</ul>
<p>在接收路径中，EthIf 会丢弃无效帧：</p>
<ul>
<li>带有无效 CtrlIdx/VLAN 的帧由测量索引 <code>ETHIF_MEAS_DROP_CRTLIDX</code> 进行计数。如果 VLAN 未处于活动状态，则所有带 VLAN 标记的帧也会被计入（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00309" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00309">[SWS_EthIf_00309]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00317" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00317">[SWS_EthIf_00317]</a>）。</li>
<li>若设置了 <code>EthIfEnableSecurityEventReporting</code>，EthIf 会向 IdsM 报告 Security Events，例如 <code>ETHIF_SEV_DROP_INV_VLAN</code>（<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00502" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00502">[SWS_EthIf_00502]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00503" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00503">[SWS_EthIf_00503]</a>）。</li>
</ul>
<p>计数器由 <code>EthIf_GetAndResetMeasurementData</code> 读取 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91011">[SWS_EthIf_91011]</a>。它们不会溢出 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00313" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00313">[SWS_EthIf_00313]</a>。不支持的测量索引会返回 <code>E_NOT_OK</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00310" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00310">[SWS_EthIf_00310]</a>。<code>ETHIF_MEAS_ALL</code> 会重置所有值 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00312" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00312">[SWS_EthIf_00312]</a>。</p>

<p class="diagram-note">活动图：接收路径中的丢弃原因及计数和 Security Events；检查顺序属于解释。来源：<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00309" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00309">[SWS_EthIf_00309]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00317" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00317">[SWS_EthIf_00317]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00502" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00502">[SWS_EthIf_00502]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00503" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00503">[SWS_EthIf_00503]</a></p>
<p>运行错误体现在返回值中：</p>
<ul>
<li>当无法更改模式时，<code>EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode</code> 返回 <code>E_NOT_OK</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_91102" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_91102">[SWS_EthIf_91102]</a>、<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_26_EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_26_EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode">SWS EthIf 第77页</a>。</li>
<li>根据文档，<code>EthIf_GetSwitchPortMode</code> 在状态 <code>ETHSWT_STATE_UNINIT</code> 和 <code>ETHSWT_STATE_INIT</code> 下也会失败 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_55_EthIf_GetSwitchPortMode.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_ETHIF_SECTION_8_3_55_EthIf_GetSwitchPortMode">SWS EthIf 第104页</a>。</li>
</ul>
<p>另外两项检查被规范为 DRAFT。对于被动收发器，EthIf 监视意外的链路丢失 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00499" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00499">[SWS_EthIf_00499]</a>。此外，EthIf 还会检查受管硬件是否达到了所请求的模式和链路状态 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00498" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00498">[SWS_EthIf_00498]</a>。</p>

<h4>进一步详细证据</h4>
<ul>
<li><a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00034" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00034">[SWS_EthIf_00034]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00264" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00264">[SWS_EthIf_00264]</a>、<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_EthIf_00266" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_EthIf_00266">[SWS_EthIf_00266]</a>：控制器模式及依赖于该模式的硬件控制。</li>
